policy: Preserve these exact bytes. Record extensions in separate versioned documents; never rewrite the baseline to match results.
local_protection: Windows ReadOnly attribute and file-scoped deny ACL for data writes, append, attribute writes and deletion, plus non-inherited deny DeleteChild on docs to prevent parent-right bypass; apply using scripts/protect_spec.ps1.
portability: Git preserves the content and this manifest, not Windows attributes or ACLs. Reapply local protection after a fresh checkout.
limitations: This is an operational safeguard, not protection against an owner or administrator who deliberately changes permissions or repository history.
